text.어떤 정보를 왜 받고, 어떻게 지키며, 무엇을 요구하실 수 있는지 적었습: This policy sets out what information we collect and why, how we protect it, and what you can request.

text.TEN AI(이하 ‘회사’)는 이용자의 개인정보를 소중히 다루며, 「개인: TEN AI (the “Company”) values users' personal information and complies with the Personal Information Protection Act and other applicable laws. This policy explains what information the Company collects on tenai.kr and why, how it protects that information, and what users can request.
text.1. 수집하는 개인정보와 이용 목적: 1. Personal information we collect and purposes of use
text.회사는 아래 경우에만 개인정보를 수집하며, 목적이 바뀌면 미리 알리고 동: The Company collects personal information only in the cases below. If a purpose changes, the Company will notify users in advance and obtain their consent.
text.계정 식별, 로그인, 답변·안내 발송: Account identification, login, sending replies and notices
text.본인 확인 (복원 불가능한 형태로 암호화 보관): Identity verification (stored encrypted in a form that cannot be restored)
text.기업 교육 과정 권한 부여: Granting access to corporate training courses
text.수준에 맞는 교재 추천: Recommending learning materials suited to the user's level
text.나. 구글 계정으로 로그인: b. Signing in with a Google account
text.구글 로그인을 이용하면 구글로부터 아래 정보를 전달받습니다. 회사는 이용: When a user signs in with Google, the Company receives the information below from Google. The Company neither receives nor stores the user's Google password.
text.다. Q&A 질문 등록: c. Posting a question in Q&A
text.질문 구분, 답변 시 호칭: Distinguishing questions, addressing the user in replies

text.데이터베이스 권한 자체를 막아 두어, 관리자가 아닌 접속에서는 조회조차: Access is blocked at the database permission level itself, so they cannot even be viewed from any connection other than an administrator's. Even for questions made public, only the name and the question and answer text are visible.
text.라. 접속 시 자동 생성되는 정보: d. Information generated automatically on access
text.서비스 운영과 보안을 위해 접속 기록, 브라우저 종류, IP 주소가 인프: For service operation and security, access logs, browser type and IP address may be recorded automatically in the server logs of our infrastructure providers. The Company does not separately view or analyze this information, and checks it only in cases prescribed by law, such as investigating a security incident.
text.회사는 광고·행태정보 수집 목적의 추적 도구를 쓰지 않습니다. 브라우저: The Company does not use tracking tools for advertising or for collecting behavioral information. Browser storage (localStorage) holds only

text.오늘 처음 왔는지, 그 창에서 처음 연 쪽인지: Whether this is the first visit today, and whether it is the first page opened in that window
text.브라우저에서 ‘추적 안 함(Do Not Track)’ 또는 GPC 를 켜: If you turn on “Do Not Track” or GPC in your browser, nothing is recorded. The collected values are viewed only as totals on the admin screen and are deleted automatically after one year.
text.회원 탈퇴 시까지. 탈퇴 요청 시 지체 없이 파기: Until the member withdraws. Destroyed without delay upon a withdrawal request

text.법령이 별도의 보존 기간을 정한 경우에는 그 기간을 따르며, 해당 정보는: Where a law prescribes a separate retention period, that period applies, and such information is stored separately and is not used for any other purpose.

text.다만 법령에 따른 요청이 있거나 이용자가 사전에 동의한 경우는 예외로 합: However, exceptions are made where there is a request under applicable law or where the user has given prior consent.
text.4. 처리 위탁 및 국외 이전: 4. Outsourcing of processing and cross-border transfer
text.서비스 운영에 필요한 범위에서 아래 사업자에게 처리를 위탁하고 있으며,: To the extent necessary to operate the service, the Company outsources processing to the providers below, whose servers are located outside Korea.

text.이전 항목·시점·방법은 위 표의 수집 항목과 같으며, 서비스 제공 기간: The items transferred, and the timing and method of transfer, are the same as the collected items in the tables above, and the information is retained for as long as the service is provided. If you do not want your information transferred, you may choose not to sign up or may withdraw your membership; in that case, some features, such as viewing members-only learning materials, will not be available.
Users may exercise the following rights at any time.
text.아래 연락처로 요청하시면 지체 없이 처리하고 결과를 알려 드립니다. 법정: If you make a request through the contact details below, the Company will act on it without delay and inform you of the outcome. A legal representative or a person you have authorized may also exercise these rights on your behalf.
Passwords are encrypted and stored in a form that cannot be restored.
All communications are encrypted with HTTPS.

text.회사는 만 14세 미만 아동의 개인정보를 수집하지 않습니다. 가입 과정에: The Company does not collect personal information from children under the age of 14. If such information is identified during sign-up, it is destroyed immediately.
